name: liftoff/select
title: Select
description: Themed native select built atop OriginSelect with semantic token styling.

files.content:
---
/**
 * @title Select
 * @level liftoff
 * @description Themed native select built atop OriginSelect with semantic token styling.
 * @category Forms
 * @hydration none
 * @accessibility
 * - Delegates label binding and persistent hints to `OriginSelect`.
 * @keyboard
 * - Native select keyboard behavior.
 * @slots
 * - `default`: Native `<option>` elements.
 */

import OriginSelect from "@lsui/origin/Select.astro";
import type { ComponentProps } from "astro/types";
import "./core.css";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof OriginSelect>;

---

<OriginSelect {...Astro.props}><slot /></OriginSelect>
